name: Employee Onboarding Process

data.label: Start Onboarding
data.trigger: HR initiates onboarding for new hire
data.description: Begins the complete employee onboarding workflow

data.label: HR Creates Employee Profile
data.instructions: Create employee profile with basic information and employment details

data.label: Send Welcome Email
data.template: Welcome email with first day information and next steps
data.description: Automated welcome email to new hire

data.label: Parallel Task Assignment
data.branches: Employee paperwork, IT provisioning, Manager orientation setup
data.description: Split workflow for parallel processing of different onboarding tasks

data.label: Employee Completes Forms
data.instructions: Complete I-9, W-4, direct deposit, emergency contacts, and acknowledgment forms

data.label: IT System Provisioning
data.instructions: Create user accounts, assign equipment, configure system access

data.label: Manager Orientation Setup
data.instructions: Schedule orientation, prepare workspace, assign department-specific tasks

data.label: Document Verification
data.description: Validate all required employee documents are complete and accurate

data.label: Document Status Check
data.description: Route based on document validation results

data.label: Document Error Notification
data.template: Documents incomplete or invalid - requires correction
data.description: Alert about missing or incorrect documentation

data.label: Parallel Tasks Complete
data.description: Wait for all parallel onboarding tasks to complete

data.label: First Day Preparation
data.description: Wait until employee's first day for final preparations

data.label: Orientation Required Check
data.branches: Requires orientation vs Skip to completion
data.description: Determine if employee needs formal orientation session

data.label: Conduct Orientation
data.instructions: Conduct company and department orientation session

data.label: AI Onboarding Assessment

data.description: AI analysis of onboarding process effectiveness and recommendations

data.label: Final Onboarding Approval
data.instructions: Review AI assessment and approve onboarding completion

data.label: Onboarding Complete Notification
data.template: Onboarding successfully completed - welcome to the team
data.description: Final notification of successful onboarding completion

data.label: Escalation Alert
data.template: Employee onboarding delayed - documents not submitted within deadline

dataModels.name: OnboardingWorkflow
dataModels.description: Tracks the overall onboarding process and workflow state for each employee including current step, progress, and completion status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the onboarding workflow

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee being onboarded

fields.name: currentStep
fields.description: Current active workflow stage (e.g., 'documentation', 'equipment', 'training', 'review')

fields.description: Overall completion progress as a percentage (0-100)

fields.description: Date when the onboarding workflow was initiated

routing.reasoning: Complex multi-step onboarding workflow with 7+ steps, role-based task assignment, parallel processing (IT provisioning while paperwork completion), and multiple decision points. Requires SQL for relational data (employees, tasks, approvals). Advanced wizard forms needed for multi-step document collection with validation. Cross-platform mobile support for field access. Ensemble approach combines workflow complexity with form sophistication and data relationships.
